public.text: The section says mCSD permits joint querying of facility and workforce data. mCSD represents care services through organisations, locations, practitioners, practitioner roles, and healthcare services, not simply two separate registries.
public.suggestedRevision: Align the component model with the full mCSD entity structure and explain how queries are federated or coordinated across authoritative sources.
